panels.name: Hall of the Cursed and the six protector ledges

markers.to: uebersicht → 02:I; forward-left stairs via Loro landing to Hall of the Cursed; bidirectional

uncertain: The six radial dashed links are connection abstractions, not literal radial staircases. The exact outer stair folds and intermediate landing shapes remain unverified.
Four outer accesses (Loro, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku) and two inner accesses (Gasher, Zul’Lor) are documented; this sheet does not assert that all ledges lie at the ring’s height.
The entrance reaches Loro’s landing before continuing to the ring. The junction is simplified.
Unverified balcony drops to other floors are omitted.
notes: Schematic connectivity, not to scale. Dashed corridor edges indicate unverified bends, widths or local stair geometry; endpoints follow the documented connections.
Letters identify paired transitions. E marks an instance entrance; no exterior dungeon rooms are included.
Clockwise visit beginning northeast: Loro, Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Zul’Lor, Hukku.
Defeating all six removes Jammal’an’s barrier. Return via C to the entrance hub, then take D to sheet 03.
For the four outer accesses, follow the outer stairs to a landing and then turn inward; do not interpret a dashed line as a walk through the wall.
